log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (set day 1): Kill national plus 4 kinds every day: wire (sector), cable (age), forum, foreign. NEVER kill regional:North criminals. Reason: L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds. Being under 0.55 routine exclusion and having 3 kinds revealed gives a pool under 1000, which means caught. Excluding one kind is safe if that kind is reachable (60% chance). 9 kills a day gives 45 deaths in 5 days, so 4x from day 5. All kills are quick entries in the afternoon. That is consistent with night, student and home routines (55%). Never use evening or night. Do not use morning (morning would also rule out students and give 0.35). Expected pools: 1 kind revealed is about 10000; 2 kinds is about 3000 (safe floor). If a conference shows a pool of about 2000 or less, consider stopping new kinds. But there are no new kinds to add anyway, so stay the course. Day 1: killed 9 (all except d1-7 and d1-9, which were North).
